H-02.evidence: F-006 identifies free unlimited self-whitelist via Whitelist.receive() (ETH refunded), i.e. anyone can whitelist themselves — the awarded 'whitelisting can be bypassed by anyone'.

H-03.evidence: F-004 captures launch DoS via moving Uniswap slot0 away from initialPoolPriceX96 (require UV3P). Awarded uses single-sided liquidity to move the price; same mechanism (price nudge -> launch revert).

M-01.evidence: Missing-feature finding (VULT token should implement burn). Not surfaced; no burn-capability analysis performed.

M-02.evidence: claim() was deeply analyzed (F-001 fee accounting, F-002 collect/transfer underflow) but the specific gap — pool.burn called with no amount0Min/amount1Min slippage control (MEV sandwich) — was not isolated.

M-03.evidence: The per-user purchase-cap subsystem was examined and an adjacent cap-bypass finding (F-006, Whitelist maxAddressCap via Sybil) surfaced, but the ILOPool.buy maxCapPerUser bypass via transferring the position NFT (balanceOf->0 then re-buy) was not isolated.
